verdict.rationale: Slate is a locally installed CLI/TUI agent (npm install). It can run background subagents across long, multi-hour sessions, and the docs claim it can perform integration tests itself, so autonomous build-and-test is partly evidenced. Nothing shows the agent running in the cloud or producing a demo artifact (recording, screenshots, preview link) for review. Missing for 10: cloud-hosted agent execution, demo/preview artifacts for review, an end-to-end handoff workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
